market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR is a historically successful IPL franchise with 3 titles in 17 seasons, winning most recently in 2024. Even the worst teams in a 10-team league have at least a ~5% chance, and KKR is likely in the upper half. A 2% implied probability significantly undervalues their chances, with a fair estimate around 12% given team quality, strong retained core, and league parity. The large edge reflects market mispricing.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL, demonstrating current competitiveness
Franchise retains star players like Shreyas Iyer, Rinku Singh, Andre Russell, Sunil Narine
Historical win rate of ~17.6% over 17 seasons, well above 2%
In a 10-team league, even the weakest team has about a 5% prior, and KKR is no bottom-feeder
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL auction/retention dynamics
